attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the cluster: node1 (10.100.99.10) as the writable primary, node2 and node3 as async read-only standbys built via pg_basebackup with a dedicated replicator role. Verified writes on node1 replicate to both standbys and standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol (node2, node3, node1) with boot-id proof of each reboot and post-restart verification of PostgreSQL activity, recovery/streaming state, and data integrity (including a post-restart write/read round trip).
